## About
Quality Smog & Repairs is a car repair and maintenance shop on Reseda Blvd in Northridge. We look at your car, tell you plainly what it needs, and do the work at a fair price.
Some of our customers have been bringing their cars to us for years, and one trusts us with the whole family's cars, from classics to new ones. One reviewer put it simply: we have never suggested work they didn't need.
We'll also be straight with you when a repair doesn't make sense. As one customer said, we'll tell you if a car is likely to become a money pit. We hold a 5 rating on Google from 26 reviews.

## Services
- 30000 mile service: One reviewer said their Subaru dealer charged just over $700 for this service, and we did the same work for a lot less.
- Trouble shooting and repairs: We track down what's wrong and fix it, with fair, honest prices.

## FAQ
Q: Are you open on Saturday?
A: Yes. We're open Saturday from 8:00 AM to 2:00 PM. We're closed Sunday.

Q: Do you work on classic cars?
A: Yes. One customer says we maintain all of their family's cars, from classic to new.

Q: Will you tell me if a repair isn't worth it?
A: Yes. If we think a car is going to keep costing you more than it's worth, we'll say so.
